title: Eliminate one variable from two plane quadrics

source.citation: Janko Boehm, Wolfram Decker, and Frank-Olaf Schreyer, Commutative Algebra and Algebraic Geometry using OSCAR, arXiv:2404.12085

translation.notes: The two source quadrics are entered independently. Noether computes the reduced monic lexicographic Groebner basis; clearing denominators recovers the two displayed OSCAR basis elements. No source transcript is redistributed.
